catalog.name: Payments
catalog.description: Ask for USDC with a QR code
catalog.about: Creates a payment request for a precise amount of USDC, addressed to this account, and shows it as a QR code any Solana wallet can pay. Your wallet reads the network itself to tell you when it was paid. Nothing is sent to a server: the code is the request.
catalog.usage: Tap + to ask for USDC and share the code. Tap the code icon to pay one you were sent, the clock to see every request.

actions.ask: Ask for an amount of USDC with a QR code
actions.track: See when a request was paid, and by whom

emptyPending.body: Paid and expired requests live in the history, behind the clock.
